title: cybele heterophylla
intro: Cybele heterophylla, commonly known as Cybele or Cebadilla, is a perennial plant species in the genus Cybele. This plant is native to Mexico and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. Cybele heterophylla has been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Cybele heterophylla include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its use to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems.
